item.title: ZettelKasten
item.description:
Sometimes I have a hard time figuring out if a note is worth my zk.

In the book How to take Smart Notes by Ahrens, you should store in your ZK:

  1. Anything that you don’t want to forget
  2. Anything that you can use in your own thinking
  3. Anything that you can use in your writing
